name: hetzner-ddns
description: This Docker image will allow you to use the Hetzner DNS Service (https://www.hetzner.com/dns-console) as a Dynamic DNS (DDNS) Provider.

variables.name: Zone Name
variables.description: The DNS zone that DDNS updates should be applied to.

variables.name: Record Type
variables.description: The record type of your zone. If your zone uses an IPv4 address use A. Use AAAA if it uses an IPv6 address.
